name: Default
shortDescription: Laya decision engine HTTP API on CPU: typed choice, score and yes/no decisions over text in 100+ languages, protected by a bearer API key.

alerts.message: The API has no web UI. Copy the generated LAYA_API_KEY from the environment and send it as a Bearer token with every request to /v1/systemone.

On first start the server downloads about 680 MB of model weights from Hugging Face before it becomes healthy and keeps the multilingual checkpoint in memory (about 2 GB of RAM). English text routes to the English checkpoint, which loads on first use and needs about 2 GB more.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
